items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So he said it's Monte Kay, the manager.

ctx.x: And we came back to New York, around '54 now, and John says, well we have a new member. I was thinking what instrument did he play to add anything, to complement Milt, what instrument could that be. So he said it's Monte Kay, the manager. So now we split the money five ways. So I said no, no manager deserves to get 20 percent.
